messages.author: 399bf2e734c020dc
messages.subject: Memory required for model predictions
parts:
Hi All,

I am trying to run a gamma hurdle model with predictions using prediction stacks, I do not have enough memory and will try remote high power computing with my university but they require that I tell them how much memory the job will need, is there a way to find this out?

my data has ~10k observations
mesh$n = ~ 350
and prediction model matrix has ~ 64k points
the hurdle model binary and count parts are fit separately

Many thanks,
Sylvan

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Memory required for model predictions
parts:
you cannot. the common approach is to try, if its fail, then increase
the memory estimate

it also depends on the number of threads used, as the required memory
for a fixed model its like

A + B * num.threads

for some A and B.

you can try with

library(INLA)
inla.setOption(inla.mode="experimental")

as this should use less memory
